relationship_to_prior_result: independent fieldsite replication with no Wellington adaptation

dataset.name: Human vocalization corpus: recordings of infant-directed and adult-directed speech and song in 21 societies

held_out.participant_selection_rule: After excluding BEJ and WEL, choose the lexicographically first fieldsite code with at least four participants having both B and D WAVs for which the four numerically lowest paired participant IDs do not appear in any retained docs/evidence file; choose those four IDs.

frozen_learner.model: four-by-four smoothed local transition counts trained only on the eight Beijing development clips

failure_policy: Retain any failed gate. Do not change participants, training clips, thresholds, states, baselines, or acceptance thresholds after fetching ARA audio.
claim_boundary: A pass would replicate the Beijing-trained causal unlabeled event-dynamics advantage in a second fieldsite beyond Wellington. It would not establish semantic prediction, IDS/ADS recognition, arbitrary-language universality, live operation, or dropout robustness.
